status: Proposed, 23 September 2026. Not the game's data yet: docs/WORKSHOP_LADDERS.md explains every choice and the decisions it needs.

assumptions.tier_income_source: tools/career_model.py proposal scenario: Coins earned while playing each tier

core.bands_open_with: tier unlocked: band n needs Tier n
core.note: Price grows 3.07x per band, matching income per tier, so each tier's band costs about the same share of that tier's Coins.

long.bands_open_with: tier unlocked: band n needs Tier n
long.note: Ten times fewer ranks than core, same band-to-band price growth.

capped.note: Percentages and engine-limited stats. Short ladders with a ceiling, no bands; bought out in the first tiers.

rows.name: Tick Speed
rows.why_capped: The tick loop runs at most 20 ticks per 0.25 s frame, so tick rate cannot scale without limit.

rows.name: Crit Chance
rows.why_capped: Crit chance is clamped at 80% in GameState.

rows.name: Auto Tap
rows.note: New job from WORKSHOP_EXPANSION.md (was Auto Crank).

rows.name: Streak
rows.unit: percent per wave, up to 20 waves

rows.name: Guard
rows.unit: x the tier's Hit pressure off every Hit

rows.name: Cushion
rows.tower_twin: Health (the Number itself is health; Cushion is only its starting value)
rows.unit: x the tier's Hit pressure, starting Number

rows.name: Bounty
rows.tower_twin: Regen (closest: Number back on every clear)

rows.name: Free Boost
rows.unit: every Nth Boost free, 12 down to 6

rows.name: Coin Bonus
rows.why_capped: Coins buy everything else; an uncapped Coin multiplier compounds with every band and runs away.
